title: Grandmother and Baby in Backyard, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-20th-century outdoor snapshot capturing an older woman, identified on the reverse as Amanda Benson, seated comfortably on the grass in a sunny yard. She wears a patterned polka-dot dress and holds a young infant or toddler, Dennis Phelps, who sits in her lap dressed in light-colored overalls. They rest under the dappled shade of a lush leafy tree with a classic residential home in the background.
